judgment.observations: The reconstruction captures the shared room layout: left-side metal bunks, exposed wall framing, a central wooden wardrobe, rear fireplace and a cropped right bunk. Framing and scale differ substantially: the right bunk occupies much more of the render, the left beds appear smaller and farther away, and the ceiling has a broad angular band instead of the reference’s dark beams. The wardrobe is shorter and lacks the reference’s clear open hanging compartment. The fireplace is smaller, with a thin surround instead of the substantial pale stone arch; the radiator, hearth accessories and wall clock are absent. Bed legs visibly meet the floor, but contact shadows are weaker. Materials differ strongly: pale, finely striped flooring replaces dark, worn wide planks; timber is lighter; walls are grayer; bedding is flatter and less detailed. The render is visibly grainy and lacks the reference’s strong directional daylight.
judgment.uncertain_3d_hypotheses: The render suggests greater spacing between the left bunks and right foreground bunk, and a lower wardrobe relative to the room, but camera position and projection could contribute to these impressions. The fireplace appears shallower and some furniture less firmly grounded because of weak shading; actual depth, support and hidden geometry cannot be determined from these images.
